description: On the countertop there’s an open cardboard box near the back, two microfiber cloths (yellow and pink), and several small rubber-duck toys clustered near the cloths. The right hand repeatedly picks up individual ducks from the cluster, lifts them up and forward toward the box, and releases them inside, while the left hand stays mostly planted on the left side and occasionally nudges items into reach; near the end the right hand drops the pink cloth into the box and both hands briefly gather the yellow cloth as if to clear it.
